heading: Information We Collect
body: When you fill out a form on our site (such as the contact form), we may collect your name, email address, and the message you send us. In addition, general technical information about your browser and device may be collected automatically while you use the site.

heading: How We Use Information
body: The information we collect is used to respond to your questions, improve our services, and contact you when necessary. We do not sell your information to third parties.

heading: Cookies
body: Our site may use cookies to improve your experience. You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings.

heading: Your Rights
body: You may request to view, correct, or delete any personal information we hold about you. Please reach out to us through our contact page to make such a request.

heading: Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any significant changes will be communicated through this page.
